excerpt: You are a nation shaped by one river, with three quarters of your land in farms and four in ten of you under fifteen.
paras: You are a nation shaped by one river, with three quarters of your land in farms and four in ten of you under fifteen. Your debt is at high risk of distress; meeting this year’s fiscal targets would set it on a declining path. Let the river, the farms and the young carry the capital for food, power and schools.

Your partners are working beside you. In May 2025 the World Bank approved $52.6 million for roads, and in November 2025 a $45 million grant to support your reforms for growth. Its grants of 2024 for health and for agriculture, $35 million and $68 million, reach the clinic and the farm, and in June 2026 it approved a regional programme with ECOWAS to bring electricity to more of your homes.

The work ahead is plain, and it is worth saying plainly. Only three in every hundred of you cook with clean fuel, though seven in ten have electricity. Only twenty-eight in every hundred of you have safely managed sanitation. Fifty-three in every hundred of you lived below the national poverty line at the last count, in 2020. Clean energy sets your Coverage today, at 3 out of 100, with sanitation and income close behind. Each of them is within your reach.

Now imagine that same resolve turned toward every home in the country. Picture Perfect The Gambia: a morning when every family cooks with clean fuel and sits down to a full table; when every tap runs clean and every home has a safe toilet; when every child walks to a school where a teacher is waiting, and reads with ease by the age of ten; when every mother lives within reach of a clinic with the lights on, and every young person finds work that pays. And no Gambian falls below a decent life, because the nation has decided that none will.
quote: One river made you a nation. Let it now make every citizen secure.
